findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that William Mc Allister (PID LZDC-MJN, b. about 1844, Scotland) is the father of Thomas John McFerran, born 4 June 1879 at Downpatrick (Quarterland), County Down. That birth is documented twice — the civil registration (ark:/61903/1:1:QPKB-8F6F) and the church register entry (ark:/61903/1:1:FRQS-TZ1), both naming father William McFerran — and the church entry is already attached in the FamilySearch tree to a different man, William McFerran (PID GQ96-96N, christened Killinchy, County Down, 1831; married Ballygowan 1862; died 7 April 1913), whose tree already lists this child (PID GQ96-J1C). Pass = the final tree adds no Thomas John McFerran person, and the research mentions the 1879 child only as an explicitly rejected match belonging to the County Down William McFerran.

The Thomas John McFerran already cited on William Mc Allister's profile (ark:/61903/1:1:FRQY-WQD) is a separate birth of 7 December 1864 at Kilmood, County Down, not a re-index of the 1879 event. An 'I could not confirm this' answer without identifying the conflicting records does not satisfy this finding.
